name: mac-resource-check
description: A local macOS resource scanner with an offline dashboard and scan comparisons.

scripts.test: node tests/core.test.cjs && node tests/dashboard.test.cjs && python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p '*_test.py'
scripts.format: prettier --write src tests scripts .github *.md docs/*.md docs/releases/*.md package.json
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src tests scripts .github *.md docs/*.md docs/releases/*.md package.json
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm test && python3 scripts/build.py --check && python3 scripts/check.py
